title: 第3章 裤裆出汗了第4章 暴露了
slug: 听我解释真不是你们想的那样
content_zh:
两天时间，眨眼便过。
“我回来了！静白你在家吗？！师弟？开门！”
林天有些郁闷，这是自己的洞府，里面的阵法竟然被换了，现在他连门都打不开！
突如其来的声音，吓了屋内两人一跳，尤其是陆沉，一瞬间就想好了遗言。
庄静白倒没那么不堪，反而开口怒骂林天。
“狗，狗男人！你咿，还知道回来！”
听到庄静白愤怒的声音，林天一下子就怂了。
“娘子，你怎么把我家阵法换了，先让我进去，慢慢和你解释！”
“谁咿是你娘子？你……唔，不是丢下我去找魅姬了吗？”
“什么？师弟都告诉你了？”林天没有注意到庄静白的短句，反而心里满是恐慌。
“哼！现在你给我道歉，什么时候我满意了，你什么时候再进门！”
庄静白留下这么一句，便不说话了，只是洞府内传来噼里啪啦的声音，显然是她在摔东西。
……
林天道了半天歉，庄静白才终于满意，打开了大门。
门开的瞬间，林天一个箭步就冲了进去。
其实陆沉说的挺对的，他这几天想了想，确实是他情绪上头了，想到这么个馊主意。
再怎么说也是自己娘子，让师弟入洞房算是什么事儿？他现在还真开始后悔了。
不过这一进门，他差点以为自己走错了地方。
只见洞府内一片狼藉，桌子歪斜，椅子倒地，床上的被褥揉成一团扔在地上，厨房里的碗碟碎了一地，阳台……
这里像是一个战场。

“这……”林天咽了口唾沫。
庄静白站在狼藉中央，凤冠霞帔早已换下，一身素白长裙，发丝凌乱，眼眶泛红，看起来像是哭了很久。
只是不知道受的什么苦，哪里流的泪。
“娘子……”林天狗狗祟祟地上前。
“你这是……何必呢？”
“何必？你丢下我跑去哄妖女，我摔几个东西怎么了？”
“没没没，应该的应该的！”林天连忙摆手，“你随便摔，摔多少我都买新的！”
庄静白冷哼一声，别过头去。
林天讪笑着，目光不经意扫过屋内。
等等。
那阳台……晾衣架上怎么挂着两件法袍？一件是娘子的，另一件像他的又不像他的？
content_en:
Two days passed in the blink of an eye.
"I'm back! Jingbai, are you at home?! Junior brother? Open the door!"
Lin Tian was a little depressed. This was his own cave, and the formation inside had been changed. Now he couldn't even open the door!
The sudden sound startled the two people in the room, especially Lu Chen, who thought of his last words in an instant.
Zhuang Jingbai was not that unbearable, but instead scolded Lin Tian angrily.
"Dog, dog man! How dare you come back!"
Hearing Zhuang Jingbai's angry voice, Lin Tian was immediately frightened.
"Madam, why did you change my formation? Let me go in first and explain to you slowly!"
"Who is your wife? You...well, didn't you leave me to find Mei Ji?"
"What? Junior brother told you?" Lin Tian didn't notice Zhuang Jingbai's short sentence, but was filled with panic.
"Hmph! If you apologize to me now, when will I be satisfied, when will you come in again!"
Zhuang Jingbai left these words and stopped talking. Only a crackling sound came from the cave, which was obviously her throwing something.
…
Lin Tian apologized for a long time before Zhuang Jingbai was finally satisfied and opened the door.
The moment the door opened, Lin Tian rushed in with a single stride.
In fact, what Lu Chen said was quite right. After thinking about it these past few days, he realized that it was indeed his emotions that got him to the point where he came up with such a bad idea.
After all, she is still my wife, so what does it mean to let my junior brother enter the bridal chamber? He was really starting to regret it now.
But upon entering, he almost thought he was in the wrong place.
I saw a mess in the cave, the table was crooked, the chair fell to the ground, the quilt on the bed was crumpled and thrown on the floor, the dishes in the kitchen were broken on the floor, the balcony...
This is like a battlefield.
"This..." Lin Tian swallowed.
Zhuang Jingbai stood in the middle of the mess. She had already changed out of her phoenix crown and Xiapei. She was wearing a plain white dress. Her hair was messy and her eyes were red. She looked like she had been crying for a long time.
I just don’t know what pain I suffered and where my tears were shed.
"Madam..." Lin Tiangou stepped forward furtively.
"You are... why bother?"
"Why bother? You left me and went to coax the witch. What happened if I threw a few things?"
"No, no, no, it should be!" Lin Tian waved his hand quickly, "You can drop it as you like, no matter how much you drop it, I will buy a new one!"
Zhuang Jingbai snorted coldly and looked away.
Lin Tiansan smiled and glanced across the room casually.
etc.
That balcony... why are there two robes hanging on the clothes drying rack? One is a lady's, and the other is like him but not like him?
